manifest.notes: Sworn on Ethereum mainnet, as specified by the approved workflow and docs/V3.md. Deploy Renderer, Composer, then Registry. Renderer draws the card and metadata on-chain; Composer composes oracle questions, validates community specs and reads direct traits. Both have no constructor arguments. Registry is the ownerless Sworn/SWORN ERC-721 registry: one transferable card per wallet, with facts bound to the minting wallet. Its seven address arguments follow the accepted constructor and ABI: curator (WhitelistCurator), imd (existing IMD token), intake (Intake v2), attester (the named IMD oracle signer), renderer, composer, burnExecutor (IMD BurnExecutor V2). All five external addresses are the approved mainnet values; both application references point to earlier deployments. IdentityMD is not a constructor dependency. These contracts grant no owner or admin role (no owner(), admin(), getOwner() or role functions), so no $owner argument is needed. Mint and registration fees are forwarded to the BurnExecutor for bridging and burning on Base; oracle requests are paid by claimants through Intake. Registry always requires code at Renderer and Composer and a nonzero attester; where Curator, IMD and Intake have code (mainnet) it also requires code at the BurnExecutor and checks curator settlement, IMD decimals and the Intake price. On an empty-chain rehearsal where those three read dependencies have no code, it skips those reads and the executor code check, so the three-contract deployment completes. Deployment uses nonpayable constructors with no initialization calls. Source publication, signed artifact linkage, policy admission and deployment simulation belong to the services; this manifest does not assert that those checks have passed.

abiInstructions: Build ABIs from this exact source commit; compare canonicalKeccak(abi) with abiHash. Verify deployed code on the stated chain before enabling transactions.
